lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh bhagatee laavahu sach naanak a(n)mrit peee jeeu ||4||28||35||
lines.translation: Shower Your Mercy upon me, God; let me be committed to devotional worship. Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of Truth. ||4||28||35||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
The Lord of the Universe, the Support of the earth, has become Merciful;
the rain is falling everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਠਾਢਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal sadaa kirapaalaa thaadh paaee karataare jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: He is Merciful to the meek, always Kind and Gentle; the Creator has brought cooling relief. ||1||
He cherishes all His beings and creatures,
as the mother cares for her children.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੇਤ ਸਗਲ ਆਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dukh bha(n)jan sukh saagar suaamee det sagal aahaare jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: The Destroyer of pain, the Ocean of Peace, the Lord and Master gives sustenance to all. ||2||
The Merciful Lord is totally pervading and permeating the water and the land.
I am forever devoted, a sacrifice to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈ ਜਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: rain dinas tis sadaa dhiaaee j khin mahi sagal udhaare jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Night and day, I always meditate on Him; in an instant, He saves all. ||3||
God Himself protects all;
He drives out all sorrow and suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: naam japat man tan hareeaaval prabh naanak nadar nihaare jeeu ||4||29||36||
lines.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are rejuvenated. O Nanak, God has bestowed His Glance of Grace. ||4||29||36||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
Where the Naam, the Name of God the Beloved is chanted
those barren places become mansions of gold.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਇਦਾ ਸੇਈ ਨਗਰ ਉਜਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jithai naam na japeeai mere goidaa seee nagar ujaaRee jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Where the Naam, the Name of my Lord of the Universe is not chanted-those towns are like the barren wilderness. ||1||
One who meditates as he eats dry bread,
sees the Blessed Lord inwardly and outwardly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਸੂ ਕੀ ਵਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: khaai khaai kare badaphailee jaan visoo kee vaaRee jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Know this well, that one who eats and eats while practicing evil, is like a field of poisonous plants. ||2||
One who does not feel love for the Saints,
misbehaves in the company of the wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics;

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਖੋਈ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੜ ਅਪੁਣੀ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dulabh deh khoee agiaanee jaR apunee aap upaaRee jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: he wastes this human body, so difficult to obtain. In his ignorance, he tears up his own roots. ||3||
I seek Your Sanctuary, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek,
Ocean of Peace, my Guru, Sustainer of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮ ਅਸਾੜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa naanak gun gaavai raakhahu saram asaaRee jeeu ||4||30||37||
lines.translation: Shower Your Mercy upon Nanak, that he may sing Your Glorious Praises; please, preserve my honor. ||4||30||37||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
I cherish in my heart the Feet of my Lord and Master.
All my troubles and sufferings have run away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)t sookh sahaj dhun upajee saadhoo sa(n)g nivaasaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: The music of intuitive peace, poise and tranquility wells up within; I dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
The bonds of love with the Lord are never broken.
The Lord is totally permeating and pervading inside and out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar simar gun gaavaa kaatee jam kee phaasaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Meditating, meditating, meditating in remembrance on Him, singing His Glorious Praises, the noose of death is cut away. ||2||
The Ambrosial Nectar, the Unstruck Melody of Gurbani rains down continually;
deep within my mind and body, peace and tranquility have come.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tripat aghaai rahe jan tere satigur keeaa dilaasaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Your humble servants remain satisfied and fulfilled, and the True Guru blesses them with encouragement and comfort. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਾ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaa saa tis te phal paaiaa ||
lines.translation: We are His, and from Him, we receive our rewards.
Showering His Mercy upon us, God has united us with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੩੮॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan rahe vadabhaagee naanak pooran aasaa jeeu ||4||31||38||
lines.translation: Our comings and goings have ended, and through great good fortune, O Nanak, our hopes are fulfilled. ||4||31||38||
Maajh, Fifth Mehl:
The rain has fallen; I have found the Transcendent Lord God.
All beings and creatures dwell in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਇਆ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gaiaa kales bhaiaa sukh saachaa har har naam samaalee jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Suffering has been dispelled, and true happiness has dawned, as we meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis ke se tin hee pratipaare ||
lines.translation: The One, to whom we belong, cherishes and nurtures us.
The Supreme Lord God has become our Protector.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਘਾਲੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sunee bena(n)tee thaakur merai pooran hoee ghaalee jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer; my efforts have been rewarded. ||2||
